Tomato___Early_blight.name: Early blight
Tomato___Early_blight.description: A fungal disease (Alternaria) that starts on older leaves and spreads upward in warm, humid weather.
symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings

Tomato___Late_blight.name: Late blight
Tomato___Late_blight.description: A fast-moving oomycete disease (Phytophthora infestans) that thrives in cool, wet conditions and can destroy a crop within days.
symptoms: White fuzzy growth under leaves in humid mornings

Tomato___healthy.name: Healthy
Tomato___healthy.description: No visible disease signs on this leaf.

Potato___Early_blight.name: Early blight
Potato___Early_blight.description: A fungal disease (Alternaria solani) that is worse on stressed or nutrient-poor plants.
symptoms: Dark target-like spots on older leaves

Potato___Late_blight.name: Late blight
Potato___Late_blight.description: The disease behind the Irish famine; spreads rapidly in cool, damp weather and can infect tubers.

Potato___healthy.name: Healthy
Potato___healthy.description: No visible disease signs on this leaf.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.name: Common rust
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.description: A fungal disease (Puccinia sorghi) favoured by cool nights and high humidity.
symptoms: Small reddish-brown pustules on both leaf sides
Pustules turn dark as the season progresses

Corn_(maize)___healthy.name: Healthy
Corn_(maize)___healthy.description: No visible disease signs on this leaf.

Apple___Apple_scab.name: Apple scab
Apple___Apple_scab.description: A fungal disease (Venturia inaequalis) that overwinters in fallen leaves and infects in wet spring weather.
symptoms: Olive-green to brown velvety spots on leaves

Apple___healthy.name: Healthy
Apple___healthy.description: No visible disease signs on this leaf.
